presentation.label: GENLOSS
presentation.summary: Tape and VHS generation loss: wow, a head-bump tone shift and hiss.
presentation.overview: Tape and VHS generation loss: wow, a head-bump tone shift and hiss.
highlights: Hold a chord and listen for the degraded, unstable tape sound.
usage: Add GenLoss from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Hold a chord and listen for the degraded, unstable tape sound.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under GenLoss.
steps: Add GenLoss from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Hold a chord and listen for the degraded, unstable tape sound.

controls.name: Wow
controls.doc: params[5]. Wow & flutter + pitch instability. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Hiss
controls.doc: params[7]. Tape hiss / noise-floor level. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Dry/wet crossfade. GenLoss previously had NO level or mix control at all -- its last knob was Hiss, a noise amount -- so it was the one effect you could not sit against the dry signal. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
